NotoSansSC.subset: pyftsubset kept the variable wght axis (100-900) and the face names. Ranges: ASCII, Latin-1 and Latin Extended, general punctuation, symbols used by the UI, CJK radicals, kana, CJK punctuation, CJK Unified Ideographs U+4E00-U+9FFF, CJK compatibility ideographs, and fullwidth forms. CJK Extension A and the supplementary ideograph planes were dropped. Characters outside the subset use the platform fallback.
